session-expired: Your sign-in has lapsed. Your marks are safe on this device; sign in again and they go to your Library.
wire-lapsed: Your agent no longer accepts the reader's permission. Sign in again to grant it; nothing on this device is lost.
your-content-empty-highlights: Verses you highlight will show up here.
about-hero-body: A Bible for those you do life with. Read and study Scripture together, online, on any device, in dozens of languages.
about-playlist-body: Gather passages, links, and videos into a path through Scripture to walk through or share.
about-sessions-body: Read live with your group, wherever each of you is. Everyone follows along in their heart language.
about-shared-body: See which chapters your friends have been reading, and stay in the Word together, even on different schedules.
about-content-body: Highlight what speaks to you and write down what you're learning. Your friends' notes show up right in the passage too.
about-mission-body: We believe access to God's Word should stay simple and dependable. Seed Bible is free forever, with no ads, no paywall, and nothing between you and Scripture.
your-content-empty-saves: Passages you save will show up here.
policy-unavailable: This text is not available in your language yet.
about-estate: This build runs on the faithnet estate: your marks live in your own Library at your Home, written by your own agent; this app keeps nothing of yours. Public things you publish are released from your shelf and indexed by the Seed registry.
profile-note: Private until you publish it; published, your friends see the name, line and picture in their Today.
connectors-none: No MCP servers are connected to your agent.
connectors-note: Attached at your Home; this reader only lists them and never calls them.
publish-as-note: As a church you steward, what you publish — notes, playlists, plans, themes — lands on the church's shelf and reaches everyone who follows it.
account-wire-held: Your highlights, notes and bookmarks go to your Library through your own agent.
account-no-wire: No wire: your marks stay on this device.
first-run-playbook: Your agent does not offer the reader's behaviour yet. Open your Home once — it gives your agent the behaviour by itself — then come back here: the reader retries on its own.
account-signin-title: Keep your marks in your Library
account-signin-blurb: Sign in with your Home. This page holds no key; your Home does the ceremony.
try-sample-people: Or try it as one of the Home's sample people
audio-auto-continue: When a chapter's recording ends, play the next chapter
presence-share: Let friends see what I am reading right now
presence-share-note: Only people who have added you back see it, and only while this tab is open; it fades by itself.
scripture-map-blurb: Every chapter of the open translation. Shaded by how often you have read it; a dot marks a highlight or note; the chapter on screen is outlined.
new-playlist-title: New playlist, starting with the passage on screen
customization-maker-blurb: A branded reader: colours for light and dark, a logo, a default translation. Publish it and readers can pick it under Church theme.
recommended-extensions-note: Turned on for a reader who picks this theme; they can turn any off.
customization-link-hint: A link that opens the reader in this theme
plan-maker-blurb: A plan from the chapter on screen, one chapter a day, up to chapter:
annotation-conflict: This note was edited on two devices. Both versions are kept until you choose one.
note-link-hint: A link that opens these verses with your published note
select-verses-to-note: Select a verse and tap Note to write one.
session-start-blurb: Start a session on the chapter you have open: you lead, friends follow you, and everyone sees your marks for the session.
session-guest-blurb: No Home? Join as a guest with the Session ID and Code the leader sent you: you follow along and chat; nothing of yours is kept.
voice-note: Voice is peer to peer between the devices on it ({{count}} connected); no server hears it. Some networks will not connect without a relay.
session-allow-guests: Let guests (no Home) join with the Session ID and Code
discover-no-body: This release has no text beside it.
discover-empty: Nothing released for this chapter yet. Publish one of your notes to be the first.
discover-how: The Seed registry indexes what people and churches release on their public shelves; it re-crawls every 15 minutes.
today-signed-out: Sign in to see your friends and what they released.
today-no-friends: No friends yet. You are friends once you have added each other at your Home.
today-no-contacts: No contacts yet. Friends are the contacts at your Home.
today-how: Friends see only what you publish. Your private marks never leave your Library.
companion-blurb: Ask about the chapter on screen (or the verses you selected). The answer comes from the estate's study model, not from a person.
compare-select: Select verses in the reader, then tap Compare.
places-none: This chapter names no place the map knows.
places-no-geometry: The map has no geometry for these places yet.
transcript-sign-in: Sign in to transcribe a recording.
transcript-note: The recording is decoded on this device and sent in two-minute pieces to the estate's speech model; nothing is kept, and nothing goes to any other service.
transcript-save-note: Save as a note on this chapter
twitch-bad-channel: That is not a Twitch channel name.
twitch-none: Name a channel to watch its stream and chat beside the text. Nothing you do here is sent to Twitch.
twitch-readonly: Twitch's own player and chat. Posting in chat happens on Twitch, under your Twitch account, never through this app.
testament-missing: {{translation}} has no {{name}}. Pick another translation to read it.
keep-screen-awake: Keep the screen on while the reader is open
playlist-history-open-failed: This playlist is no longer in your Library.
session-qr-alt: QR code to join this session
toolbar-customize-hint: Choose which tools sit in the toolbar, and their order. The others are under More.
tutorial.tabsBody: Your open passages and saves live here.
tutorial.paneLayoutBody: Choose how many passages to read side by side from this layout menu.
tutorial.addTabBody: Add a new tab to read several books or translations side by side.
tutorial.toolbarBody: You can customize the toolbar to your liking. By default, book selection, navigation, and search are built in.
tutorial.settingsBody: Customize themes, text, and more here, or install the app to your device.
tutorial.mobileBooksBody: Tap the book name to jump to a different book or chapter.
tutorial.mobilePassageBody: Tap the translation name to jump to a different translation.
tutorial.mobileToolbarBody: Switch between the Bible, search, and more from the bottom bar.
tutorial.mobileSettingsBody: Customize text, themes, and reading options here.
tutorial.selectorSearchBody: Search by chapter, verse or book from here.
tutorial.selectorBooksBody: Choose a chapter from here to begin reading.
tutorial.selectorTestamentBody: Show all books, or narrow to just the Old Testament, New Testament, or extra-biblical writings.
tutorial.offlineDownloadTitle: Tap to keep it on your device
tutorial.offlineDownloadBody: Any translation with this icon can be saved for offline reading.
tutorial.skipPromptBody: You can turn tutorials back on later from Settings. Would you like to stop seeing them, or just skip this one?
tutorials-on: Short tours show the first time you use a feature.
shared-save-play: Save to my Library and play
shared-save-start: Save to my Library and start
shared-theme-missing: This theme is not listed yet. Try again in a minute.
shared-gone: This page is not shared any more
shared-gone-body: Whoever shared it may have taken it down, or the link is incomplete.
reading-plan-session-empty: No readings yet in this session
plan-reading-unknown: That is not a passage this Bible knows.
reading-plan-needs-name: Give your plan a name to save it
reading-plan-no-readings: Add at least one reading to create the plan
crop-unreadable: That file is not a picture this browser can open.
crop-hint: Drag the picture to move it; zoom to fit.
earlier-pictures-none: Pictures you upload are kept here to use again.
text-style-hint: The font of the book title, headings and verses.
theographic-empty: Open a person, place or event from Discover.
theographic-unreadable: This record could not be read.
friends-need-permission: To show your friends, the reader needs your permission to ask your agent. Sign in again to give it — nothing on this device is lost.
friends-unreadable: Your friends could not be read just now.
picture-drop-hint: Choose a picture, or drop one here
picture-not-image: That file is not a picture — choose a JPEG, PNG, GIF or WebP.
full-screen-install-body: Install Seed Bible and it opens on its own, without the browser's bars.
full-screen-ios-1: Tap Share (the square with an arrow) in Safari's bar.
full-screen-ios-2: Choose Add to Home Screen, then Add.
full-screen-ios-3: Open Seed Bible from your home screen: it fills the screen, without Safari's bars.
full-screen-other: Use your browser's menu: Install app or Add to Home screen, or its full-screen mode (F11 on a computer).
full-screen-scroll: In the browser, scrolling down the chapter also folds its bars away.
profile-saved-device: ✓ Saved on this device — sign in to keep it in your Library
profile-save-failed: Saved on this device, but not yet in your Library: {{reason}} Tap Save to try again.
session-share-how: Send friends the link (it carries both), or have them open Live session and enter the Session ID and Code.
session-record-saved: A record of this session is kept in your Library.
friend-sign-at-home: Sign at your Home to add {{name}} — the window that opened. Check the name there before you sign. This updates by itself when you are done.
friend-asked: ✓ Asked {{name}}. You are friends once they accept.
friend-link-message: {{name}} would like to be friends on Seed Bible:
friend-add-placeholder: Their name at a Home, like ruth.me
friend-link-hint: Send it to anyone. Opening it in the reader lets them add you in one step.
friend-invite-what: Friends see what each other publish in Today, and when the other is reading. Nothing of yours is shared until you publish it.
friend-invite-self: This is your own friend link — send it to a friend.
friend-asked-before: You asked {{name}} before; adding them again sends the request again.
verse-check-verified: Checked: these words match the published text
verse-check-differs: These words do not match the published text
verse-check-not-in-corpus: This verse is not part of the published translation
verse-check-none: This verse could not be checked
scripture-checking-long: Checking each verse against the published text…
scripture-no-verification: This copy carries no published fingerprints to check against (a downloaded copy, or a source that does not publish them). Open it online to check it.
scripture-unreachable: The published fingerprints could not be reached just now, so this chapter was not checked. It will be checked when they can be.
scripture-verified-long: All {{count}} verses match the published {{translation}}, word for word.
scripture-differs-long: These verses do not match the published text: {{verses}}. They are marked in the chapter. The rest match.
scripture-unattested-long: The words match the fingerprints this copy came with, but those fingerprints are not signed by the scripture agent, so they cannot be trusted.
scripture-check-step-words: Each verse's words were fingerprinted on this device and compared with the fingerprint published for it.
scripture-check-step-corpus: Each fingerprint was proven to be one of the {{count}} in this translation's published set.
scripture-check-step-attested: That set is signed by the scripture agent (scripture-resolver.svc) through its signing key.
scripture-check-step-not-attested: The set's signature did not check: {{reason}}.
scripture-check-limit: Checked here, on this device. Whether the agent's signing key is still authorised is confirmed by a validator, not here.
tutorial.promptTitle: Welcome to Seed Bible. Would you like a tutorial?
tutorial.promptBody: A guided tour is available to help you learn the ins and outs of Seed Bible.
onboarding.installBodyPost: to return anytime. You can always find this option later in Settings.
onboarding.iosStepsPost: in the toolbar, then choose “Add to Home Screen”.
install-body-post-settings: or your phone's home screen to return anytime.
customize-make-your-own: Make your own in Library → Customizations
bookmarks-empty: No bookmarks yet. Use the bookmark button above a chapter to place one.
translation-not-served-body: {{id}} is not among the Bibles this reader serves. Read this chapter in another translation.
profile-signed-out-message: Sign in to keep your highlights, notes and plans on every device.
friends-row-subtitle-empty: Add friends and see what they're reading
account-settings-subtitle: Sync, publishing, connected sources and more
profile-save-needs-home: Saved on this device, but not yet in your Library.
huddle-none: Talk and see each other while you read. Your microphone and camera start off.
delete-image-confirm-message: Delete this image? This can't be undone.
your-content-empty: Notes, highlights, saves, playlists and reading plans you make will show up here.
your-content-empty-annotations: Notes you write will show up here.
your-content-empty-bookmarks: Chapters you bookmark will show up here.
your-content-empty-playlists: Playlists you create will show up here.
your-content-empty-reading-plans: Reading plans you create will show up here.
your-images-empty: Images you upload as covers for playlists and reading plans will show up here.
friend-remove-at-home: Confirm at your Home to remove {{name}} — the window that opened. This updates by itself when you are done.
friends-empty: No friends yet. Share your friend link, or add someone by their name at a Home.
friends-signed-out: Sign in to add friends and see what they're reading.
remove-friend-confirm-message: Remove {{name}} as a friend? You'll both stop seeing each other's reading.
your-friend-link-description: Share your friend link. Anyone who opens it can send you a request.
feed-empty: No activity in this time frame yet.
feed-empty-notes: No notes in this time frame yet.
feed-empty-reading: No reading in this time frame yet.
feed-history-empty: Chapters you read will show up here.
session-connection-lost: You lost connection to the session. Reconnecting…
folder-name-taken: A folder with that name already exists.
bookmark-limit-reached: You can have up to {{max}} bookmarks. Move or remove one to make room.
bookmark-move-hint: Tap a bookmark to move it to this chapter.
cancel-translation-download-unknown-size: Downloading {{size}} so far — tap to cancel
no-translation-results-found: No results found. Would you like to expand your search to include partial and incomplete translations as well?
saving-translation-to-device: Saving to this device… {{percent}}% — tap to cancel
translation-download-failed: Couldn't download {{name}}. Tap its download button to try again.
update-offline-translation: A newer version is available — tap to update
remove-offline-translation-message: Remove "{{name}}" from this device? You'll need a connection to read it again.
appoint-co-host-instructions: Choose someone to keep the session running:
session-close-confirm-message: Closing this will end the session for everyone.
session-settings-verse-effects-desc-ever: Show effects when anyone selects a verse.
session-settings-verse-effects-desc-host: Show effects when a host selects a verse.
session-settings-verse-effects-desc-none: Verse selection effects are turned off for everyone.
session-settings-host-only_note: Only the session host can change these settings.
session-settings-navigate-desc_host: Only the host can change the passage for everyone.
session-settings-navigate-desc_all: Everyone in the session can change the passage.
session-settings-highlight-desc_host: Only the host can highlight for everyone.
session-settings-highlight-desc_all: Everyone in the session can highlight.
session-settings-share-translation-desc_: Everyone reads the same translation. Changing it updates it for everyone.
Each person keeps their own translation. Changing yours won't affect others.
link-to-join-shared-session-copied: A link to join the shared session was copied to your clipboard
session-qr-error: Couldn't generate a QR code. Copy the session link to share it instead.
session-qr-scan-description: Opens this passage, in this session, on their phone.
session-qr-subtitle: Let others scan to join this session.
share-current-session-subtitle: Copy a link to invite others to read along live
share-embed-subtitle: Add this passage to a website
start-share-session-subtitle: Invite others to read along live
